Dermatitis.description: Visual analysis identified purulent exudate, epidermal collarettes, and localized erythematous furunculosis characteristic of deep bacterial pyoderma.
indicators: Purulent exudate and active tissue inflammation
Dermatitis.recommendedProtocol: Systemic Cefalexin (22-30 mg/kg q12h PO for 21-28 days) or Amoxicillin-Clavulanate + topical 3-4% Chlorhexidine antiseptic washes.

Fungal_infections.description: Visual examination shows greasy keratosebaceous exudate, lichenification, and pronounced hyperpigmentation in intertriginous folds, indicating Malassezia dermatitis.
Fungal_infections.recommendedProtocol: Twice-weekly Miconazole (2%) and Chlorhexidine (2%) medicated baths + Oral Ketoconazole/Itraconazole 5-10 mg/kg q24h for refractory cases.

Healthy.description: Visual screening confirmed no active lesions, epidermal scaling, pustules, or parasitic crusting. The animal exhibits intact hair follicle density and a healthy sebum barrier.
indicators: Intact hair follicle density with uniform coat coverage
Intact stratum corneum barrier with healthy sebum layer
Complete absence of erythema, papules, pustules, or crusting
Normal epidermal elasticity, turgor, and clear skin architecture
Healthy.recommendedProtocol: Routine preventative ectoparasite prophylaxis and balanced dietary omega-3/6 essential fatty acid supplementation.

Hypersensitivity_Allergic_Dermatitis.scientificName: Canine Atopic Dermatitis / Ctenocephalides felis hypersensitivity
Hypersensitivity_Allergic_Dermatitis.description: Bilateral symmetrical erythema and excoriations observed along ventral and lumbosacral regions, indicating an IgE-mediated allergic response (Flea Allergy or Atopic Dermatitis).
indicators: Salivary fur staining from compulsive licking and chewing
Secondary excoriations from chronic scratch trauma
Hypersensitivity_Allergic_Dermatitis.recommendedProtocol: Oclacitinib (Apoquel 0.4-0.6 mg/kg) or Lokivetmab (Cytopoint IL-31 monoclonal antibody) + year-round Isoxazoline flea preventive.

demodicosis.scientificName: Demodex canis / Sarcoptes scabiei var. canis
demodicosis.description: Visual analysis detected severe follicular inflammation, concentrated periocular and pinnal alopecia, and hyperkeratotic crusts consistent with parasitic mite infestation (Demodex / Sarcoptes).
demodicosis.recommendedProtocol: Single oral dose of Fluralaner (Bravecto) or Afoxolaner (NexGard) + twice-weekly 2% Chlorhexidine baths for secondary bacterial overgrowth.

ringworm.description: Distinct annular circular fur loss with erythematous margin and peripheral cigarette-ash scaling observed. High clinical suspicion of zoonotic dermatophytosis.
indicators: Broken hair stubs with ectothrix fungal spores
High zoonotic transmission risk to handlers
ringworm.recommendedProtocol: Oral Itraconazole (5 mg/kg pulse) + topical Miconazole dip. Strict patient isolation and environmental decontamination with dilute bleach.
